changelog.name: WaEnhancerX v2.0.5
changelog.body:
[Added]
- Added support for version 2.26.43.xx
- Time Format (12/24 hours) for timestamp
- In-App Screenshot / Screen Recording restrictions bypass
- Send seen to specific Status
  - Seen button in status view reply bar (Experimental)
- Added module settings for Hooking method (Lightweight, Balanced, Maximum Capability, Customized)

[Improvements]
- Removed obsolete Facebook Grid and Compact List status layouts
- Enhanced Download Profile Picture with optional "Save Duplicates" confirmation
- Enhanced Download Status with optional "Save Duplicates" confirmation
- Improved Floating bottom navigation customization
- Hooks injection Optimized
- Flexible removal of Meta AI
  - Remove Home FAB 
  - Remove Meta AI entry points
  - Block Meta AI chat
- Improved bootloader spoofer with support of play integrity to avoid WhatsApp Ban / Unverfied app issue (Experimental) 
  

[Fixed]
- Send blue ticks
- Blue ticks on reply
- Remove Meta AI


[Feature: Floating bottom bar]
- Horizontal Inner Padding
- Selector type: Default, Oval
- Selector Color
- Hide Tab Labels (Icons Only)
- Other improvements

[Feature: Hooking Method]
- Hooking method is a new feature that allows you to hook WhatsApp in different ways. 
- You can choose between 3 different hooking methods:
  - Balanced: Hooking some features on Startup, some features on demand (lazy injecting) for a balance between battery consumption and compatibility.
  - Maximum: Hooking every feature on Startup for maximum compatibility.
  - Lightweight (Pro): Hooking minimal features on Startup and more features on demand (lazy injecting) for minimum battery consumption.
  - Customized (Pro): You can customize the hooking method for each feature.

[Feature: Bootloader Spoofer]
- Introduced Play Integrity & Roadblock Bypass: Intercepts WhatsApp's aggressive device integrity checks and suppresses unofficial app verification roadblock screens dynamically.
- Tested on latest WhatsApp beta release (2.26.43.2). If your environment requires strict hardware-backed attestation for SMS/registration verification, ensure your device passes Device Integrity (e.g., using a valid keybox via Bootloader Spoofer or tools like PlayIntegrityFix/TEESimulator).


[Notes]

![Upcoming WhatsApp floating bottom bar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WaEnhancerX/WaEnhancerX/main/samples/upcoming-whatsapp-floating-bar.jpeg)

- Floating bar new features are inspired from WhatsApp's soon upcoming update of Floating bottom bar design.
- You can enjoy the same experience before WhatsApp even launches in beta. 
- Use these values to get a similar experince:
  - Horizontal Inner Padding: 5dp
  - Vertical Inner Padding: 0dp
  - Selector type: Oval
  - Selector Color: App Default or by your choice (with 30% opacity)
  - Hide Tab Labels (Icons Only): True
  - Icon Size: 26dp
  - Shadow: Enabled
  - Selected/Unselected Icon color: App Default or by your choice.


[Community contribution]
- Thanks to @TheKillerMax for valuable contributions in this update.

changelog.name: WaEnhancerX-v1.6.9
changelog.body:
[Added]
- **WhatsApp Support**:
  - Full compatibility with WA/WB versions up to **2.26.23.xx**.
- **Floating Bottom Navigation Bar**:
  - Implemented a smooth floating pill-shaped bottom navigation bar with layout adjustments and transitions.
- **WaEnhancerX Pro Features**:
  - Introduced the premium license verification framework tied to device hardware (via Telegram bot `@waenhancerx_bot`).
  - **Always Typing [Pro]**: Added *Always Typing* and *Always Recording Voice* states.
  - **Message Bomber [Pro]**: Added a message-bombing utility with adjustable delays.
  - **Media Deletion [Pro]**: Added option to completely delete message media files directly from local storage.
  - **Status Splitter [Pro]**: Implemented a status video splitter with full obfuscation support to automatically post long status videos.
  - **Status View Customizations [Pro]**: Custom status playback controls, layouts, fast-forward/rewind gestures, playback speed controllers, play/pause buttons, and options to hide/disable reply bars, quick reactions, and heart buttons.
- **General Enhancements**:
  - Added option to make message text selectable inside chat bubbles.
  - Added toggle to hide the new Meta AI tab on the Home Screen.
  - Added user configuration to select between embedded settings inside WhatsApp or launch as an external standalone application.
  - Added a multi-step "Report Issue" flow with title input and validation checks.

[Improvements]
- **Database & Query Performance**:
  - Integrated a one-time database index optimization to resolve lags (especially when the *Separate Groups* feature is active).
  - Optimized conversation scrolling performance.
- **UX & Design Polish**:
  - Rounded custom bottom sheets and alert dialog buttons to match modern pill-shaped designs.
- **App Size Reduction**:
  - Decoupled `App.java` from licensing using dynamic reflection, purged verbose debug logs, and removed the unused native `DexKit` dependency to decrease package size.

[Fixes]
- **Media & Audio**:
  - Fixed sending local media files as voice notes and resolved transcoding issues with the Audio-to-Opus utility.
  - Fixed crashes in `AudioPlayerDialog` when loading corrupt or unplayable audio files.
- **Seen Ticks & Online Status**:
  - Resolved seen tick (Hide Blue Ticks) issues.
  - Fixed Hide Typing & Recording voice status hooks.
- **Compatibility & Crash Fixes**:
  - Resolved `MODE_WORLD_READABLE` exceptions in Xposed initialization.
  - Fixed nested preference fragment crashes and navigation errors.
  - Implemented fallback method-resolution logic in `Unobfuscator` for floating action button hook failures.
  - Restored chat date separators (Today, Yesterday, etc.) that were missing under time customization.

# WaEnhancer X **UI customization, automation, and privacy engine for WhatsApp on Android** WaEnhancer X is an open-source Xposed/LSPosed module for rooted Android that enhances WhatsApp and WhatsApp Business with privacy controls, anti-delete recovery, view-once media tools, interface customization, and productivity features—without repackaging the official app. 👉 [![Source Welcome](https://img.shields.io/badge/PRs-welcome-brightgreen.svg)](CONTRIBUTING.md) **[Latest Release](https://github.com/WaEnhancerX/WaEnhancerX/releases/latest)** · **[Telegram Community](https://t.me/waenhancerx)** · **[Documentation](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)** · **[Report Bug](https://github.com/WaEnhancerX/WaEnhancerX/issues)**
--- ## Star History [![Star History Chart](https://api.star-history.com/chart?repos=waenhancerx/waenhancerx&type=date&legend=top-left)](https://www.star-history.com/?repos=waenhancerx%2Fwaenhancerx&type=date&legend=top-left) --- ## Contents - [Star History](#star-history) - [Why WaEnhancerX](#why-waenhancerx) - [About V2 Architecture](#about-v2-architecture) - [Key Features](#key-features) - [Compatibility & Supported Clients](#compatibility--supported-clients) - [Requirements](#requirements) - [Installation Guide](#installation-guide) - [Building from Source](#building-from-source) - [Architecture & Design Principles](#architecture--design-principles) - [Contributors](#contributors) - [Community & Policies](#community--policies) - [Important Notice & Disclaimer](#important-notice--disclaimer) - [License](#license) --- ## Why WaEnhancerX Most WhatsApp modifications require replacing your official application with suspicious, closed-source third-party repackaged APKs. These third-party APKs pose major account security risks, break safety attestation, and often bundle unwanted bloatware or trackers. **WaEnhancerX takes the native Xposed framework approach:** - **Zero Client Tampering:** Works directly on top of the unmodified, genuine WhatsApp client from Google Play. - **Deep System-Level Integration:** Injects settings natively into WhatsApp's internal preferences screen with full search engine support. - **Dynamic CSS Theme Engine:** Style message bubbles, action bars, backgrounds, and UI layouts without decompiling or patching XML assets. - **Local History and Exports:** Stores preserved-message history and media exports on the device. Network-dependent features and update checks have their own settings and behavior. --- ## About V2 Architecture The public manager and hooks use Kotlin/Java, Jetpack Compose, Hilt and Android framework APIs. Features are grouped into packages inside `:app`, with a required private `:licensing` module. The [architecture guide](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) maps the implemented components and their responsibilities. The APK declares `minSdk 24` and `targetSdk 36`. These build settings do not imply that every feature has been verified on every Android version or future host release. Compatibility depends on the target APK, loaded hook framework and individual hook behavior. --- ## Key Features
### 🛡️ Privacy & Security - **Anti-Delete Protection:** Prevent incoming messages from disappearing when sender deletes them. - **View-Once Tools:** Controls for viewing and exporting view-once media on compatible host builds. - **Self-Delete History:** Maintain local archives of messages you delete for yourself. - **Receipt Control:** Granular control over blue ticks and delivered receipts. ### 🎨 Customization & UI - **CSS-like View Engine:** Fine-tune bubble colors, radiuses, and backgrounds with declarative rules. - **Meta AI Cleanup:** Hide intrusive Meta AI icons, floating action buttons, and chat entries. - **Material You (Monet):** Dynamic color theming aligned with system wallpaper palettes. ### ⚡ System & Integration - **Native Settings Injection:** Integrated right inside WhatsApp’s official settings hierarchy. - **Built-in Search:** Instantly locate any tweak via native search bar indexing. - **Safe Restart Policy:** Graceful, reliable WhatsApp process restart directly from the dashboard. - **Tasker Integration:** Open a selected WhatsApp chat through the supported, user-confirmed automation flow.
--- ## Compatibility & Supported Clients WAEX targets exact package names and evaluates configured version-name rules before initializing its feature registry. | Target package | Client | Scope of the declaration | |---|---|---| | `com.whatsapp` | WhatsApp Messenger | Declared target; version rules and feature-specific acceptance still apply. | | `com.whatsapp.w4b` | WhatsApp Business | Declared target; version rules and feature-specific acceptance still apply. | | Other explicitly listed packages | Alternative clients | Exact allowlist membership only; no authenticity or compatibility guarantee. | See the [Client Compatibility Guide](docs/client-compatibility.md) for the actual allowlist, built-in/custom rules, explicit bypass and unavailable-input states. A matching rule or a green source test does not prove that every feature works. --- ## Requirements 1. A rooted Android device with a working Xposed-compatible framework such as LSPosed, configured for that device. 2. An installed target client listed in the module's scope and admitted by its configured version rules. 3. An Android version allowed by the APK's declared minimum SDK (currently API 24), plus framework and target-client compatibility. This is not a device test matrix. The [manifest](app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml) declares the Xposed metadata and [arrays.xml](app/src/main/res/values/arrays.xml) declares the recommended scope. --- ## Installation Guide 1. **Download:** Select the desired Debug or Release APK from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/WaEnhancerX/WaEnhancerX/releases) and read that release's notes. 2. **Install:** Install the APK on the Android device. 3. **Activate:** Enable WaEnhancerX in the loaded framework's manager. 4. **Set scope:** Enable **WaEnhancerX** (`com.waenhancer`) and the installed target, such as `com.whatsapp` or `com.whatsapp.w4b`. System Framework (`android`) is not part of the declared scope in this source tree. 5. **Restart and inspect:** Restart the selected processes as required by the framework, open the WAEX manager, and inspect its compatibility and injection diagnostics. Then check the configured entry point in the target app. The current build configuration enables code minification and resource shrinking for Release. Debug uses a different optimization configuration; it is still an APK archive. A feature working in Debug must also be checked in optimized Release before a release-specific issue is considered resolved. --- ## Building from Source The repository currently declares SDK 36, JDK/toolchain 17, Android Gradle Plugin 9.0.1 and a Gradle distribution of 9.1.0 in the wrapper properties. Use an Android Studio version compatible with that AGP release. The Kotlin catalog entry is 2.0.20; the resolved Gradle plugin/compiler version also depends on AGP and should be recorded when validating a full build. **A public clone alone cannot produce the configured APK.** Both Debug and Release require the private `:licensing` module and the original configured signing key; the build verifies its certificate during configuration. The current revision declares a licensing URL in `.gitmodules` but contains no gitlink or pinned licensing commit, so recursive submodule initialization alone cannot supply it. Builders with access must obtain it separately: ```bash git clone https://github.com/WaEnhancerX/WaEnhancerX.git cd WaEnhancerX git clone https://github.com/mubashardev/waex-licensing.git licensing ``` Before building, select a compatible licensing revision supplied by the maintainers and record both commit SHAs. Configure the Android SDK and authorized signing properties as described in [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md), then run: ```bash ./gradlew :app:assembleDebug ``` The configured output is `app/build/outputs/apk/debug/WaEnhancerX-v_debug.apk`; Release uses `app/build/outputs/apk/release/WaEnhancerX-v_release.apk`. `VERSION_NAME` comes from [gradle.properties](gradle.properties). Public-source checks can run without the private module or signing key. See [Development Setup and Tests](CONTRIBUTING.md#development-setup) for prerequisites, commands and the distinction between source QA, local unit tests and device tests. --- ## Architecture & Design Principles The manager uses `WaexPreferenceManager` and `PreferenceSchema`; injected features read settings through `PreferenceBridgeClient` and `HookProvider`. `MainHook` selects declared targets and invokes `VersionGuard` before `FeatureRegistry` initializes the feature implementations. - [Current architecture and source map](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) - [Client targeting and version-rule decisions](docs/client-compatibility.md) - [Preference stores, backups and provider authorization](docs/preference-architecture.md) These documents describe the public code.
